meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会只读地分析仓库里所有 open 的 issue 和 PR,每个条目启动一个后台任务,把带 GitHub 永久链接证据的报告写入 /tmp/{datetime}/。它不会在 GitHub 上评论、合并、关闭或打标签。
howto.when: 当你提到 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等关键词时触发,它接管该仓库开放 issue 和 PR 的分析。

say.text: triage 这个仓库所有 open 的 issue 和 PR
say.note: 每个条目生成一份带永久链接的报告

say.text: 只 triage issue,不要评论或关闭任何东西
say.note: 全程只读,不改动 GitHub 上任何状态
报告以文件形式写入指定目录

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude read-only analyzes every open issue and PR, one background task per item, and writes reports with GitHub permalinks to /tmp/{datetime}/. It never comments, merges, closes or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "triage", "triage issues" or "triage PRs". It then handles analysis of the repo's open issues and PRs.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues and PRs in this repo
say_en.note: Each item gets its own report file

say_en.text: Triage the issues, but don't comment or close anything
Triage PRs and write the reports to /tmp
say_en.note: Reports land as files in that directory
